title: Hot Spinach and Artichoke Dip
description: Crowd-pleasing spinach and artichoke dip with crumbled bacon and Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) can quartered marinated artichoke hearts, drained
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (5 ounce) container garlic-herb flavored cheese spread

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until browned and crispy, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain on paper towels and crumble when cool enough to handle.
Combine artichoke hearts, spinach, Parmesan, sour cream, cheese spread, and mayonnaise in a mixing bowl. Add crumbled bacon and mix thoroughly. Spread mixture into a 7x11-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

video.description: If you're looking for a good spinach artichoke dip, look no more! This cheesy and creamy dip is the perfect comfort food. Quick and easy– just mix together spinach, artichoke hearts, garlic-herb flavored cheese, Parmesan cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise. With an additional touch of crumbled bacon, this recipe will soon be a family favorite!
